title: Assistant Professor, Economics
description:
Anticipated Start Date: August 2027

Summary of Job Duties and
Responsibilities:Applicants in all fields of
economics will be considered. The successful candidate must
demonstrate a commitment to excellent teaching as well as a
promising research agenda. The typical course load would be three
courses per semester and may include web instruction.

Minimum Education Requirements:Ph.D. in
Economics or a related field is required. ABDs with a documented
plan of completion by appointment date will be considered.

Equal Opportunity Employer/AA.
